notes: jinshu:053:s0205 identifies 禕 as 張華息, the son of Zhang Hua appointed to accompany the crown prince.
The peer source identifies 張鎰: 奸人幸其危，多論奪田宅奴婢，曜大恐，獨宰相張鎰力保護。
This is a distinct referent: different Chinese identity name and/or a different source career and polity. The English transliteration alone does not connect these people.
